per_episode.instruction: Grab the red can, drop it in the basket with rounded edges, and lift the basket with rounded edges.
Pick up the red can, place it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Use the left arm to put the can with shiny smooth surface in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips; the other arm lifts the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

Use the left arm to pick up the rounded can with smooth printed surface, put it into the medium-sized basket with perforated texture, the other arm lifts the medium-sized basket with perforated texture.
Use the left arm to set the lightweight cylindrical metal can in the medium-sized basket with perforated texture; another arm lifts the medium-sized basket with perforated texture.
